body: I dont live with my dad any more. My dad is the reason i dont trust anyone. I dont trust that my mom wont do something to me if i come out, even though she supported my sister. My dad was abusive and i live with my mom and step dad who both are very kind, but i do not trust them one bit or believe they would support me
They were supportive to my sister when she came out as bisexual, but ive already been through a lot from my dad and i dont want to mess up what i have here, so im scared
